# replace program, component flood over 0/color; bbox seed tile phase.
code='''def transform(grid):
 g=[r[:] for r in grid]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
 for color in sorted(set(v for row in g for v in row if v not in (0,8))):
  seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==color]
  sr0=min(r for r,c in seeds); sr1=max(r for r,c in seeds); sc0=min(c for r,c in seeds); sc1=max(c for r,c in seeds)
  tile=[[g[r][c] for c in range(sc0,sc1+1)] for r in range(sr0,sr1+1)]
  # region is contiguous background area connected to colored seed; 8 blocks it
  seen=set(seeds); stack=seeds[:]
  while stack:
   r,c=stack.pop()
   for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
    y,x=r+dr,c+dc
    if 0<=y<H and 0<=x<W and (y,x) not in seen and g[y][x] in (0,color):
     seen.add((y,x)); stack.append((y,x))
  for r,c in seen:
   g[r][c]=tile[(r-sr0)%len(tile)][(c-sc0)%len(tile[0])]
 return g
'''
